opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest direct flight
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com flights for a given trip type, route(s), date(s) and number of travellers with direct flights only, sort by Fastest, select the top flight, choose the flexible ticket and continue.
steps: Open the Flights tab
Pick the trip type (One way / Multi-city) and tick 'Direct flights only'
Clear the default origin and type the origin city, then select the airport
Type the destination city and select the airport
For multi-city, add the second leg's origin and destination
Pick the departure date for each leg
Set the number of adults if it's more than 1, then click Done
Click Search
Click the 'Direct only' stops filter and sort by Fastest
Click 'See flight' on the top result, then Select
Choose the Flexible ticket and click Next

instances.values: One way, BLR Bangalore -> GOI Goa, 29 Mar 2023, 2 adults, direct, Fastest, Flexible ticket
Multi-city, New York -> Tokyo on 1 Jun 2023, Tokyo -> DEL New Delhi on 5 Jun 2023, 1 adult, direct, Fastest, Flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: Search Expedia rental cars for a pick-up/drop-off location, a date range and times, then apply car-type, capacity or company filters and a sort.
steps: Click the Cars tab
Click Pick-up, type the location and pick the suggestion
Set the drop-off location (same as pick-up) if needed
Open the date picker, pick the pick-up and drop-off dates, then click Done
Set the pick-up and drop-off times if they aren't the defaults
Click Search
Tick the filter checkboxes (car type, capacity, rental company)
Choose a Sort by option if needed

instances.values: JFK pick-up/drop-off, Apr 3-6 2023, 9:00 am-6:00 pm, filters 2-5 passengers + Luxury, sort Total Price
San Francisco, Apr 8-9 2023, default times, filters Avis + Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search with filters
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by destination, departure port and month, then refine the results by number of guests or deals.
steps: Open the 'Sail To' dropdown and pick a destination
Optionally open 'Sail From' and pick a departure port
Optionally open 'Dates' and pick a month
Click SEARCH CRUISES
On the results page, open 'Number of Guests' (or another filter) and set the value
Close the filter popover

instances.values: Panama Canal, from San Francisco CA, Oct 2024, filter removed on results
Caribbean, any port and date, 4 guests

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: Look up planned service changes for a transit route on new.mta.info, optionally for a specific date.
steps: Open Planned Work / Planned Service Changes (from the nav or menu)
Type the route in 'Search Routes' and select it from the list
Optionally open the date picker, go to the month you want and pick the day
Read the results

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero airport parking for an airport and a date range, then sort the results.
steps: Click the Airport tab
Type the airport name or code and select the suggestion
Set the parking start and end dates in the calendar
Change the sort dropdown (e.g. Shuttle Time)
